safety.title: SITE SAFETY
safety.subtitle: Building with
safety.description: We prioritize the health and safety of all individuals involved in the construction process. From employers to employees, subcontractors to vendors, every person on-site is integral to the successful and safe completion of each project.
safety.description2: Our team adheres to the highest local and international safety standards to minimize risks and ensure an accident-free environment. We believe that a secure workplace fosters peak productivity, quality craftsmanship, and mutual trust with our clients.
safety.f1Desc: Daily hazard assessments, mandatory safety briefings, and strict PPE enforcement across all active job sites.
safety.f2Desc: Routine compliance inspections and regular safety training conducted by certified occupational safety officers.
safety.f3Desc: A proactive culture ensuring that every workforce member returns home safely at the end of every single day.

fca.title: FCA warning to shareholders
fca.content: We have been made aware of a number of entities falsely claiming to be, or to be affiliated with, our company. These entities are using our name and branding without authorization to solicit investments. Please be cautious and verify any communication through our official channels.

scam.title: Recruitment scam
scam.content: We have become aware of fraudulent job offers and recruitment scams falsely claiming to be from our company. Please note that all legitimate job opportunities will be posted on our official careers page and we will never ask for payment during the recruitment process.

fraud.title: Fraudulent email orders
fraud.content: There have been reports of fraudulent emails claiming to be from our company requesting orders or payments. Please verify all purchase orders and invoices through our official contact channels. We will never request payment to personal accounts or through unverified channels.
